# Jimmy Forbis
After spending nearly two decades managing public finances, utilities, and city operations, I am looking to continue serving South County as an independent advocate for transparent, accountable water governance.
DonateLearn My Platform
Jimmy Forbis
Candidate, District 1
Santa Clara Valley Water District
Connect on LinkedIn
A Message from Jimmy
## Our water future is too important to leave to chance.
Friends and neighbors of District 1 —
The Santa Clara Valley Water District manages one of the most critical public resources in our region. Every decision made at that board table affects the water you drink, the reliability of your supply during drought years, the health of our local watersheds, and how your ratepayer dollars are spent.
I'm running because District 1 deserves a board member who brings real accountability, data-driven thinking, and a genuine commitment to our community's long-term water security — not just political talking points.
I've spent years studying water policy, infrastructure, and environmental stewardship in the Santa Clara Valley. I know the issues. I know what the data says. And I know what our neighbors need. I'm asking for your support so we can build a more resilient, transparent, and environmentally responsible water district — together.
— Jimmy Forbis
Learn more about Jimmy
## Where I Stand
Three priorities. Real solutions. Accountable leadership.
01
### Water Supply Reliability
40%
of California's water supply faces critical infrastructure gaps by 2030
I will push for accelerated investment in reservoir capacity, groundwater recharge programs, and drought-resilient infrastructure that protects District 1 residents for decades to come.
02
### Environmental Stewardship
12,000+
acres of watershed land in the Santa Clara Valley requiring active management
Our watershed is our most valuable asset. I will champion science-based conservation policies, habitat restoration, and responsible land management that keeps our water clean and our ecosystems healthy.
03
### Fiscal Accountability
$700M+
annual district budget that demands transparent, responsible oversight
Ratepayers deserve to know their money is being spent wisely. I will bring rigorous financial oversight, independent audits, and clear public reporting to every major district expenditure.

A well-funded campaign means more conversations with neighbors, more community events, and a stronger voice for District 1 on the water board. Every contribution counts.
